headline: Heat warning ends Monday — beans overdue, tip canes at dawn.
weather_notes: Work only before 9 AM through Monday — Extreme Heat Warning active through midnight Aug 10 with 99°F today and 98°F Monday.
Run both zones Monday morning — today's irrigation resets the clock; 98°F Monday triggers the 1-day heat re-water threshold.
Shade e1–e4 tomato beds by 11 AM today — Phoenix harvest opens Aug 24 and sunscald risk stays high at 99°F through the warning period.
Plan heavier garden work for Tuesday — warning expires Monday night and Tuesday's 96°F opens the week's first full outdoor work window.

surfaced_tasks.title: Tip new blackberry primocanes if 3–4 ft tall
surfaced_tasks.reason: 30 days overdue — before-9-AM Monday is the last heat-warning window; Tuesday's cooler forecast makes this the best two-day stretch to get it done.

suggested_tasks.title: Harvest c2/c3/c4 beans — past peak
suggested_tasks.description: Jade Bush and Red Swan Bush planted May 28 are 16–19 days past their 54–57-day maturity window — check pods for tough texture or bulging seeds and harvest before they dry out entirely.

suggested_tasks.title: Pull soft-necked w4 onions now
suggested_tasks.description: Super Star and Yellow Sweet Spanish at 106 days are deep in their maturity window — pull any bulbs with soft necks before sustained 96–99°F this week accelerates post-maturity rot.
